import cv2,numpy as np
im=cv2.imread('first_frame.png')[:,:,::-1].astype(np.float32)
# fit a 2d quadratic to local table background around ball, using pixels outside disk r55 within box
Y,X=np.mgrid[180:350,260:490]
pix=im[180:350,260:490]
r=np.sqrt((X-365)**2+(Y-258)**2)
sel=r>58
# polynomial x,y and cross
A=np.stack([np.ones(sel.sum()),X[sel]/100,Y[sel]/100,(X[sel]/100)**2,(Y[sel]/100)**2,(X[sel]/100)*(Y[sel]/100)],1)
coef=np.linalg.lstsq(A,pix[sel],rcond=None)[0]
print('coef',coef)
# residual stats
pred=A@coef
print('res std',np.std(pix[sel]-pred,axis=0), 'mean',np.mean(pix[sel]-pred,axis=0))
# produce bg in box and save
AA=np.stack([np.ones(X.size),X.ravel()/100,Y.ravel()/100,(X.ravel()/100)**2,(Y.ravel()/100)**2,(X.ravel()/100)*(Y.ravel()/100)],1)
bg=(AA@coef).reshape(pix.shape).clip(0,255).astype(np.uint8)
cv2.imwrite('.tmp/bgfit.png',bg[:,:,::-1])
# put at center
PY"
